examples.text: Фонетические соотношения между словом языка-источника и словом языка-восприемника подчиняются иным правилам, чем при родстве, но и здесь это не просто совпадение звучаний.

glosses: Relating to the sounds of spoken language.
Relating to phones (as opposed to phonemes).
Relating to the spoken rather than written form of a word or name, as opposed to orthographic.

examples.text: All unfamiliar names have been transcribed in phonetic spelling.

glosses: In such writing systems as the Chinese writing system, the portion of a phono-semantic character that provides an indication of its pronunciation; contrasted with semantic (which is usually the radical).

examples.text: I suspect that 田 dien is the original character and true phonetic of the whole group.
In the first case the character is pronounced identically, even as to tone, as the phonetic.
Or, the semantic may wrap around the phonetic, or position within the phonetic.

glosses: Que pertenece o concierne a la voz o el habla humanas.
Referido a alfabetos o sistemas de escritura, organizado por medio de signos que representan sonidos.
Referido a grafías o sistemas de transcripción del habla, organizado para representar los sonidos de un modo más exacto o preciso que los de la ortografía tradicional de un idioma.
Que pertenece o concierne a la Fonética (estudio de los sonidos lingüísticos).
che riguarda i suoni articolati in una lingua o in un dialetto

examples.text: Počínaje r. 1818 psal Karadžić pravopisem fonetickým a národním jazykem, kterému dostalo se od protivníků přezdívky »govedarski« (pastušský).
